import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv('titanic.csv')

# Drop missing values per-column
age = df['Age'].dropna()
fare = df['Fare'].dropna()

# Calculate skewness and kurtosis using scipy.stats with default settings
age_skewness = stats.skew(age)
age_kurtosis = stats.kurtosis(age)
fare_skewness = stats.skew(fare)
fare_kurtosis = stats.kurtosis(fare)

# Count values within one standard deviation from the mean (sample std, ddof=1)
age_mean = age.mean()
age_std = age.std(ddof=1)
fare_mean = fare.mean()
fare_std = fare.std(ddof=1)

age_within = ((age >= age_mean - age_std) & (age <= age_mean + age_std)).sum()
fare_within = ((fare >= fare_mean - fare_std) & (fare <= fare_mean + fare_std)).sum()

# Round skew/kurtosis to two decimals
age_skewness = round(age_skewness, 2)
age_kurtosis = round(age_kurtosis, 2)
fare_skewness = round(fare_skewness, 2)
fare_kurtosis = round(fare_kurtosis, 2)

print(f"@age_skewness[{age_skewness}]")
print(f"@age_kurtosis[{age_kurtosis}]")
print(f"@age_values_within_one_stdev[{age_within}]")
print(f"@fare_skewness[{fare_skewness}]")
print(f"@fare_kurtosis[{fare_kurtosis}]")
print(f"@fare_values_within_one_stdev[{fare_within}]")
EOF
